name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Emergency Shelter Pod ESP-2
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Emergency Shelter Pod ESP-2
description: A self-deploying emergency shelter that expands from a backpack-sized package into a rigid, sealed habitat capable of sustaining one person for 72 hours. The ESP-2 deploys in 10 seconds using a shape-memory alloy frame that springs into a 2-meter pod when released. The shelter includes atmospheric filtration, water recycling, emergency rations, basic medical supplies, and a distress beacon. The pod's shell provides ballistic protection against small arms fire and NBC protection against chemical and biological threats. It is designed for survival in hostile environments — natural disasters, combat zones, contaminated areas — where getting to safety is not possible and waiting for rescue is the only option.
story_hooks: A deployed ESP-2 was found in an alley with its occupant dead inside — the shelter was sealed and functional but the occupant had been dead for days before anyone noticed the pod.
ESP-2 pods are being used as improvised housing in Tier 1 — clusters of deployed shelters form small communities where each pod provides better protection than the buildings they replaced.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, military-grade survival capsule that transitions from a reinforced tactical backpack into a rigid, ovoid emergency habitat. The packed form is sleek and utilitarian; deployed, it becomes a self-contained bunker with a smooth, armorlike exterior.
physical_description.dimensions: Packed: 55cm H × 35cm W × 20cm D (backpack form). Deployed: 200cm L × 100cm W × 100cm H (oblong pod)
physical_description.weight_description: 8 kg packed — handheld/carry-strap weight. Deployed pod is rigid but lightweight due to shape-memory alloy frame and composite shell.
physical_description.primary_material: Shape-memory titanium-aluminum alloy frame (deployed structure), ballistic-rated composite shell (polymer-ceramic hybrid), reinforced technical fabric exterior (packed state)
physical_description.finish: Matte tactical gray with subtle metallic fleck; deployed pod surface has a subtle diamond-plate texture for grip. Weather-sealed seams visible at panel joints.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary, with high-visibility safety orange trim on pack handles and deployment toggles. Internal pod walls are pale cream with color-coded system panels.
physical_description.interface_elements: Packed: dual deployment toggles (red, recessed), 7-segment LCD status readout (power/integrity/beacon), tactile latch system. Deployed: sealed hatch with interior override wheel, small circular viewport, integrated control panel with atmospheric/water/beacon controls, emergency ration access port, medical kit compartment marked with white cross.
distinctive_features: Spring-loaded deployment frame visible as geometric seams when packed
Beacon antenna that extends from top of deployed pod (retractable)
Three small drain/exchange ports along pod base for emergency water/waste
Faint Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries logo (stylized ⟨◆⟩) embossed on pack exterior
Wear-resistant grip patches on pack shoulders
Glow-in-dark emergency exit marking (chevron pattern) on interior hatch
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries logo; regulatory stamps (GLMZ Standard 2224-NBC-Tier2, Ballistic Rating 3, Emergency Beacon ID printed on label); serial number on pack and pod. Small QUANTA price label (Φ18,500 typical retail).
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine, military-clean condition when new; worn units show scuffed pack fabric, faded trim, and dust accumulation around seams. Deployed pods often show impact scorches or microfractures from real-world deployment in harsh conditions.
